title: A constant before < is compared, not read as type arguments
purpose: Verify that comparisons start with a constant (PI < 3.2, E < PI, LIMIT <= size) while a type name with a lower-case letter keeps its type arguments.

provenance.expected_basis: 3.14 < 3.2, 2.71 < 3.14, 10 <= 12; 10 < 12 < 20 and 3.14 > 2.71; an empty Maybe falls back to LIMIT.
